answer.reason: Belgium is an older European population, with roughly two-thirds of the population in the 15-64 age group. The value around 63.56% is consistent with World Bank age-structure data, whereas ~59.84% is too low for Belgium.

metadata.prompt:

A. 59.8437111172079%
B. 63.5639803078539%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Population ages 15-64 (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.1564.TO.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)
